description: Trigger evals for harvest-session-learnings: it fires when a session or task produced durable, reusable lessons that should be appended to LEARNINGS.md, while capture-observation, slice-closure, task-close and compact-task-memory handle one in-flight note, closing a slice, archiving a task, and shrinking task memory.

should_trigger: that migration fix took three tries and the cause was surprising. Write down what the next task should do differently.
Long session, we burned two hours on a flaky test before finding the shared fixture. Sweep this and propose entries for LEARNINGS.md so it isn't lost.
before I close the laptop: what did we learn today that is worth keeping for future tasks?
Go through the task artifacts and the chat, pull out the generalizable lessons, skip the one-off trivia, and don't touch the entries already in LEARNINGS.md.
we hit the same cache invalidation bug twice this week, capture it as a lesson

should_not_trigger.prompt: Quick note to self: I suspect the retry loop is what causes the duplicate emails, check it later.
Slice 04 is done and reviewed. Can it close, and what is the state going into slice 05?
Everything is merged and every slice is closed. Finish the task and move the folder to archive.
TASK_STATE.md has grown huge after eight slices and resuming takes forever. Shrink it but keep the decisions and next step.
Write a short Slack note for the team on where the migration stands today.
